title: Certify and execute equation stage layout
summary: Execute semantic row intent as measured, certified, and applied stage geometry before canonical glyph measurement; eliminate foldable distribution crowding at wide and phone sizes; preserve measured-paint alignment; then complete simultaneous opaque x fusion.

verificationRecords.command: theseus workspace validate; theseus plan run
verificationRecords.notes: Workspace validates with 807 nodes; complete v1 contract has 26 approved slices, broad verification, exact stop conditions, mandatory slice 24 checkpoint, and the target done-contract gate passes.
69 tests pass including deterministic native/native, native/material, and material/material overlap classification.
All application, node, test, and domain TypeScript projects accept the generic diagnostic.
One phone browser case samples five representative phases and durably proves visible intersections remain while layout is declaration-only.
72 tests passed, including symmetric bounded allowance, identity non-exemption, and invalid allowance rejection.
TypeScript compilation passed after adding explicit contact types and evaluator.

verificationRecords.scope: slice s04 proof carrying layout types
verificationRecords.notes: 72 focused tests pass; foldable intent retains semantic row behavior and is explicitly marked intent.
Inference fixture proves intent, measured, certified, and applied states are not assignable across proof boundaries; compiler cost remains below ceilings.

verificationRecords.scope: slice s04 proof carrying layout types
verificationRecords.notes: Application, node, test, and domain projects accept the opaque lifecycle types and renamed foldable intent surface.
22 focused tests pass, including stale revision, mixed coordinate-space, snapshot propagation, and compositor-session identity.
12 canonical renderer tests pass across fraction responsive fitting, opacity, readiness, and revision invalidation.
Opaque proof fixtures pass and remain below compiler-cost ceilings.
All TypeScript projects accept required revision and coordinate-space propagation.
76 tests pass, including actual foldable endpoint closure, missing/duplicate/cross-transition rejection, partial/foreign membership rejection, mixed identity rejection, and nested groups.
Opaque proof fixtures and compiler-cost limits pass with the sole measured-input constructor.
All TypeScript projects accept complete measured-envelope and branded input contracts.

verificationRecords.scope: slice s07 pure single row planner
verificationRecords.notes: 79 tests pass, including tight endpoint containment, native baseline preservation, deterministic zero transform, and 100 randomized translation-invariance fixtures.
Only the measured-input certifier can produce the branded single-row certificate; inference limits pass.

verificationRecords.scope: slice s07 pure single row planner
verificationRecords.notes: All TypeScript projects accept the certified single-row occupancy contract.

verificationRecords.scope: slice s08 pure two row planner
verificationRecords.notes: 83 tests pass, including wide/phone fixtures, semantic row-order determinism, measured em/ink gutter, common centering, and 100 randomized non-overlap cases.
Two-row certification remains reachable only from branded measured input; inference ceilings pass.

verificationRecords.scope: slice s08 pure two row planner
verificationRecords.notes: All TypeScript projects accept measured typography scale and certified two-row geometry.
87 tests pass, including row-separated protected corridor, direct/lifted route selection, material clearance, full swept containment, determinism, and invalid transit rejection.
A row certificate cannot type-check as a corridor certificate; inference ceilings pass.
All TypeScript projects accept the corridor-certified layout and transit contracts.

progress.summary: Slice s09 upgrades row geometry to a separate corridor certificate: material clearance expands the row gap, same-row transit lifts through the protected band, cross-row transit stays direct, and swept bounds include all motion.

expectedLearning: Whether proof-carrying stage layout plus measured occupancy is sufficient to eliminate crowding without operation specific motion geometry.
allowedWork: Measured stage layout certificates, semantic envelope measurement, responsive fit integration, local compositor occupancy input, one foldable distribution exemplar, bounded canonical lifecycle and motif typing, tests, visual evidence, and Theseus records.
disallowedWork: Second runtime, renderer, compositor, clock, lifecycle category, scheduler category, operation specific coordinates, browser wrapping, glyph text inference, persisted DOM geometry, unrelated deferred work, or user owned dirty files.
